title: solutioncomponent
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdonbehalfby, modifiedonbehalfby, rootsolutioncomponentid_solutioncomponent, solutionid.

componenttype.description: The object type code of the component.

createdon.description: Date and time when the solution was created.

ismetadata.description: Indicates whether this component is metadata or data.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the solution was last modified.

objectid.description: Unique identifier of the object with which the component is associated.

rootcomponentbehavior.description: Indicates the include behavior of the root component.

rootsolutioncomponentid.description: The parent ID of the subcomponent, which will be a root

solutioncomponentid.description: Unique identifier of the solution component.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the solution.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the solution.
